text:
leena: ran a sustained onboarding run and hit a weird pattern: paginators stall for ~2s then a burst. Repro: ./devtools/loadgen --clients=50 --pages=10 --pattern=mixed.

omar: which sdk/sampleapp?

leena: js-quickstart + local js-sdk. logs:
```
WARN limiter: queued (scope=global) inflight=210
DEBUG paginator: holding cursor waiting for permit (page=4)
INFO auth: refresh started by caller=worker-7
INFO retry: scheduled immediate retry bypassing limiter
ERROR api: 403 transient_token
```

noah: "bypassing limiter" is key here. Retry path fast-tracks to reduce latency but when refresh is slow we end up with a synchronized retry flush.

tara: JS SDK uses a global leaky-bucket; go samples use per-route semaphores. That mismatch plus paginator holding cursors is the perfect storm.

leena: quick mitigation: update sampleapp to create separate client instances per logical route so the limiter isn't shared. That reduces interference for demos.

omar: longer term fixes we discussed: 1) add limiter.scope config (global|client|route) 2) force retries to honor limiter.acquire() 3) implement SDK-level singleflight for token refresh 4) change paginator to async prefetch of next-token so it doesn't hold permit while waiting.

noah: another idea: introduce a small circuit-breaker on paginator when hold-time > threshold (e.g., 2000ms): return a soft-fail to caller or degrade gracefully and schedule background retry. Prevents piling up cursors.

tara: I like circuit-breaker but don't want silent failures in sampleapp. Maybe circuit trips only in canary with telemetry. Emit paginator.hold_ms and limiter.queue_depth to monitor regression.

leena: Implementation notes for auth singleflight: use Map<key,Promise> with TTL slightly less than token TTL. On refresh start set promise, other callers await it. On resolve, remove key; on fail, remove and propagate error. Unit test should assert only one refresh RPC for 10 concurrent callers.

omar: For limiter.scope: default to global for backward compat, add per-route opt-in. Update docs. Make all retry code paths call limiter.acquire() and include a tiny jittered delay after auth refresh before retrying to avoid synchronized bursts.

noah: For paginator change: PREFETCH_NEXT=true behavior: return current page immediately and spawn next-page fetch in background, storing token in in-memory prefetch cache. Provide config to fall back to old behavior. Unit and e2e tests required.

tara: Tests: devex/load-e2e job that runs mixed traffic for 2m and asserts no stall >3s and no auth 5xx spike. Add unit tests for singleflight and retry honoring limiter.

ci-bot: please open issue area/devex and tag test/e2e + priority/medium.

leena: I'll open PR branch feat/devex/paginator-circuit and include repro harness and canary plan. Assigning @omar for limiter changes and @noah for auth singleflight.

omar: I'll add telemetry and a feature flag for limiter.scope.

noah: Will implement singleflight + tests. Also will add metric auth.refresh.concurrent_count.

tara: Great. Let's ship behind flags and monitor telemetry. Post links here when PRs ready. :thumbsup:
